promotion_policy: readiness-only; no update-count, elapsed-time, or plateau-only promotion
matched_control: same held text window's crisp full-depth next-token readout and raw embedding projection

readiness.strata_policy: every adequately sampled final-pass length/start-tail and available last256 stratum must pass independently
readiness.threshold_status: provisional reuse of existing alignment gates; root review required before promotion

stages.promotion: all pass-2 held strata clear matched-crisp readiness
all pass-4 held strata clear matched-crisp readiness
all pass-7 held strata clear matched-crisp readiness

objectives: full-stack completion against aligned gold tokens and raw next-token embeddings
distinct shallow feedback projection against aligned gold embeddings
one-stage sketch self-target credit from existing local_stage_write
real document close supervision only when the original span contains close
stages.qualification: exposure evidence only; task, stopping, and runtime gates remain separate

sampling.source: same admitted text windows, with document/source groups and split ownership preserved
sampling.easy-first: begin from representative, shorter semantic spans tagged by source/task provenance; keep categories represented and record selection digests; never replace held data or synthetic-close document spans
sampling.capacity: respect heads.max_length; record actual selected capacity and truncation per example

resumption: serialize scheduler stage and threshold-bound transition receipts with complete model/optimizer/RNG state
